title: Using synthetic data in Child and Adolescent Mental Healthcare – a resource planning feasibility study
summary: A feasibility study exploring synthetic data generation for resource planning in child and adolescent mental healthcare, covering data synthesis, quality/privacy evaluation, and utility evaluation via classification and clustering. It runs SDV's HMASynthesizer for multi-table synthesis and its evaluate_quality/run_diagnostic functions to assess synthetic data quality and privacy against the real CAMH dataset.
